system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Diplomacy and Society, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Commerce Lore, Lore of a traded commodity, Lore of a merchant guild.
system.description: Your livelihood depended on finding buyers and giving them a reason to return. You learned how much a promise could be worth, and how expensive it became when someone failed to keep it.
